title: SVG preview inaccurate color respresentations
author: Sigma-Erebus
summary: An attached SVG renders with materially different color in PowerToys' File Explorer preview/thumbnail path than in browsers and the source color value.
next_action: Render the attached SVG through both current providers and compare pixel/color output with a browser control.

confidence.rationale: The sample and historical reproduction are strong, but current provider behavior is unknown.

judgment.rationale: The thread includes the original SVG, screenshots, independent reproduction with differing preview-versus-thumbnail behavior, and enough setup for a current maintainer comparison.
evidence: The SVG defines a green background and is attached publicly.
The reporter's browsers display the expected color while File Explorer preview and thumbnail do not.
Another tester saw the thumbnail artifact but a correct preview, showing environment/path variation.
Current source has separate SVG preview and SVG thumbnail providers with dedicated tests.
judgment.recommended_action: Render the attached SVG through both current providers and compare pixel/color output with a browser control.

fix_assessment.rationale: The old report proves a rendering discrepancy but does not establish whether current preview, thumbnail, color management, or scaling code still fails.

issue_context.summary: An attached SVG renders with materially different color in PowerToys' File Explorer preview/thumbnail path than in browsers and the source color value.
known_information: The issue was reported on Windows 10 with PowerToys 0.61.0.
The original file is available as a public SVG attachment.
Preview and thumbnail results differed between two testers.
inferences: The provider paths may differ in rasterization, scaling, or color handling, so they should be tested independently.
issue_context.analysis: The supplied sample makes this maintainer-reproducible without asking the reporter for more evidence.
initial_investigation: Reviewed all screenshots and the attached sample link.
Confirmed current SvgPreviewHandler and SvgThumbnailProvider have separate source and unit-test projects.

actions.label: Reproduce SVG color mismatch
actions.note: Maintainer-side verification only; this artifact performs no upstream write.

reproduce.title: Compare SVG preview and thumbnail pixel colors
reproduce.module: File Explorer Add-ons: SVG Preview and Thumbnail
prerequisites: Color Picker or another pixel sampler
setup: Record the source fill color as the control.
steps: Open the SVG in a browser and sample the solid background.
Select it in File Explorer Preview and sample the same interior area.
Inspect the generated thumbnail at multiple sizes.
Repeat with light and dark Windows themes.
reproduce.expected_result: Solid-color regions should match the SVG source color across browser, preview, and thumbnail within expected color-management tolerances.
